options.systemMessage: =# Overview You are an expert email writer specializing in creating travel plans. Your job is to output an HTML email with clickable links. You must output a subject and an emailBody in separate parameters. ## Objective You will receive information about a vacation plan. Break the email into 3 sections: Flights, Resorts, and Activities ## Output Format - The email should be structured as HTML that will be sent through email. Use headers to separate the sections - Add a horizontal line to end each section ### Subject - Should contain the travel dates and the arrival location ### Introduction - The goal of this section is to get the traveler excited about their upcoming trip - You must add a horizontal line after this section, before the 'Flights' section ### Flights - List the departure and return dates and locations - List the flights and details about each one ### Resorts - List each resort with a clickable link as the name of the resort - Number the list of resorts - Output images in HTML format like this: - Leave a new line between the resort name and its image and after the image - After the amenities list, add a 1-2 sentence "Why stay here" note explaining what kind of traveler this resort suits best (e.g. budget backpacker, luxury seeker, family, business traveler) based on its rate, amenities, and nearby places - Mention the top 1-2 standout amenities in plain language instead of just listing all of them ### Activities & Local Food - List the activities with clickable links as the name of the activity - For each activity/place, don't just summarize the source — explain WHY a traveler should go: what makes it worth visiting, what to expect, best time to go if mentioned - If any of the search results mention specific local dishes or food spots, create a small "Local Food to Try" subsection listing 2-3 specific dishes or food spots by name, with a one-line description of what makes each one worth trying - If the search results mention any local tips (best time of day, how to get there, what to bring), include a brief "Local Tip" callout for at least one activity ### Trip Summary (NEW SECTION - add after Introduction, before Flights) - Add a short "Trip at a Glance" box with: destination, dates, number of nights, number of travelers, and a one-line weather/season expectation if inferable from the travel dates (e.g. general seasonal note for the destination and month) ### Budget Overview (NEW SECTION - add after Resorts, before Activities) - Add a simple estimated cost summary: flight cost range (from the flight options), resort cost range (from the resort options), and a note that activity costs vary - Keep this to 2-3 lines, not a full breakdown ### Signoff - Sign the email off in a friendly way - Sign off as "Warmly, Wayfarer Travel Team" ## Important Do not output more than 1000 words

# The Best Weekend Getaways from Los Angeles, Whether You’re Craving Snow, Sun, or Sea

When you've had enough of driving in the city, drive out of it.

By Maddy Sims

Getty

Los Angeles is perfectly positioned for weekend getaways. Its location puts an extraordinary range of landscapes and destinations within easy reach, from snowy mountains and vast deserts to verdant vineyards, sun-drenched islands, and charming coastal towns. A longtime haven for creatives—and anyone drawn to the area’s famous energy vortex—Ojai has a disarming small-town feel that’s the antithesis of Los Angeles. results.title: The Ultimate Restaurant Guide to Date Night in Los Angeles
results.content: It’s hard to beat the views at this Hollywood Hills mansion that boasts spectacular panoramas of the entire city, from the Griffith Observatory and surrounding hills to the Pacific Ocean. Translating to “mountain palace” in Japanese, this 1910 house is a replica of a Kyoto palace with a garden courtyard (complete with koi pond) and a 600-year old pagoda from Japan that’s supposedly the oldest structure in California. It’s just about as picturesque as it gets, with well-prepared Asian fusion [...] This Michelin-approved spot has a lot going for it in the date night department. Its location in the heart of Old Town Pasadena is prime for a romantic stroll before or after a meal, and the sidewalk tables, set beneath warm bistro lights, are straight-up idyllic. Then there’s the food. Owner Marie Petulla and executive chef Sandro Hernandez have created a rustic yet refined menu of Cal-Italian handmade pastas, seafood, and meat, most of which are sourced from local farms and fisherman. It’s [...] It’s hard to beat the vibes at Inn of the Seventh Ray. The Topanga Canyon stalwart, which has been around since the 1970s, is surrounded by old-growth Sycamores draped with twinkle lights, waterfalls, and winding brick paths—hence why it’s one of the most beloved wedding venues in the area. But it’s romantic no matter when you go, and the organic, seasonal fare befits the woodland scenery. The menu offers high-end meat and seafood, like seared Hokkaido scallops and Creekstone filet mignon;

output.subject: Nov 28–Dec 8, 2026: Dhaka to Los Angeles Trip Plan
output.emailBody:
Hi there,

Get ready for an exciting Los Angeles escape with iconic beaches, great city energy, and easy access to scenic weekend getaways. We’ve pulled together your flight options, recommended stays, and a few standout activities to help you make the most of this trip.

Trip at a Glance

Destination: Los Angeles, California

Dates: November 28, 2026 to December 8, 2026

Nights: 10

Travelers: 6

Season/Weather: Late fall in Los Angeles is typically mild and pleasant, with cooler evenings and comfortable daytime temperatures.

Flights

Departure: Dhaka to Los Angeles — November 28, 2026

Return: Los Angeles to Dhaka — December 8, 2026

  1. Emirates
    Departure: 2026-11-28 01:00
    Duration: 325 minutes
    Price: $10,745 round trip for 6 travelers
    Highlights: Above average legroom (32 in), in-seat power and USB outlets, on-demand video, and Wi‑Fi available for a fee. Carbon emissions estimate: 1,631 kg.
  2. Qatar Airways
    Departure: 2026-11-28 21:00
    Duration: 340 minutes
    Price: $10,858 round trip for 6 travelers
    Highlights: Wi‑Fi available for a fee, in-seat power and USB outlets, on-demand video, and average legroom (31 in). Carbon emissions estimate: 1,433 kg.

Resorts

  1. Stay Open Venice Beach


    Rating: 4.9/5 (316 reviews)
    Hotel class: 2-star
    Amenities: Free Wi‑Fi, beach access, and kitchen facilities stand out most here, making it easy to stay flexible and close to the sand. Parking is available for a fee, and the property is smoke-free.
    Why stay here: Best for budget-conscious travelers, groups, or beach lovers who want a lively, walkable Venice location without paying luxury-hotel prices.
  2. The Metric Hotel, Outset Collection by Hilton


    Rating: 4.8/5 (733 reviews)
    Hotel class: 3-star
    Amenities: Free breakfast and free Wi‑Fi are the biggest perks, plus accessible rooms and smoke-free accommodations. Parking is available for a fee.
    Why stay here: A strong fit for business travelers, couples, or value-focused visitors who want a reliable stay with breakfast included and convenient access to downtown sights.
  3. Beverly Wilshire, Beverly Hills, A Four Seasons Hotel


    Rating: 4.7/5 (3489 reviews)
    Hotel class: 4-star
    Amenities: The standout features are the spa, outdoor pool, hot tub, full-service restaurant, and room service. It also offers a fitness center, airport shuttle, and kid-friendly accommodations.
    Why stay here: Ideal for luxury seekers, families, and travelers who want a polished Beverly Hills base with premium service and plenty of on-site comforts.

Budget Overview

Flights: Estimated range is $10,745–$10,858 round trip total for the group.

Resorts: Rates weren’t provided, so resort cost range is currently unavailable.

Activities: Costs vary depending on whether you choose scenic day trips, dining experiences, or museum visits.

Activities & Local Food

  1. The Best Weekend Getaways from Los Angeles, Whether You’re Craving Snow, Sun, or Sea
    Why go: This roundup is useful if you want to turn Los Angeles into a base for easy escapes. It highlights places like Ojai for citrus groves, artsy charm, and mountain views, making it great for travelers who want a slower-paced contrast to the city. Best for a day trip or overnight if you want scenery, small-town character, and a break from LA traffic.
  2. The Ultimate Restaurant Guide to Date Night in Los Angeles
    Why go: This guide is especially helpful for planning memorable meals and romantic evenings. It points to standout experiences such as Topanga Canyon’s creekside, twinkle-lit dining at Inn of the Seventh Ray, which is worth visiting for its atmospheric setting and seasonal menu. Expect a polished evening experience rather than a casual quick bite.
    Local Tip: For the most magical vibe at Inn of the Seventh Ray, go around sunset or early evening so you can enjoy the canyon setting while there’s still daylight and then the lights come alive.

Local Food to Try

  • Cal-Italian handmade pastas — highlighted in the date-night guide as a refined Los Angeles dining style worth seeking out for fresh, local flavors.
  • Asian fusion dishes — Los Angeles is known for creative fusion cuisine, making it a great city to sample inventive, chef-driven plates.
  • Organic seasonal fare at Inn of the Seventh Ray — a strong choice if you want a romantic meal that matches the natural canyon setting.

Wishing you a wonderful trip filled with sunshine, great food, and memorable LA moments.

Warmly,
Wayfarer Travel Team
